{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Compute number of duplicate rows
is_duplicate = data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)
duplicate_row_count = is_duplicate.sum()

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
unique_patient_count = len(data_dedup)

# Print the required numbers
print(duplicate_row_count)
print(unique_patient_count)"}
